title: Race Condition and Business Logic Flaw Rules

rules.name: Race condition in state-changing balance or inventory operation
rules.description: Balance, credit, stock or quota is updated with a read-modify-write pattern without database row-level locking (select_for_update, with_for_update) or concurrency locks, allowing race-condition double spending.

rules.name: Missing positive bounds check on financial or quantity input
rules.description: Amount, quantity or price read from client request body or form is used in arithmetic or storage without positive bounds validation (checking <= 0), enabling negative-value tampering and credit inflation.
